description: This file defines the NoteRepository class, which manages CRUD operations for notes and categories stored locally in SharedPreferences as JSON. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching notes, as well as managing categories.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing CRUD operations and search functionalities for notes and categories, persisted in SharedPreferences as JSON data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, deserializing them from JSON stored in SharedPreferences, and returns them sorted by last updated timestamp descending.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID if it exists.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Adds or updates a note, updating its last modified timestamp, and persists the list. Also ensures its category is stored.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a note by its ID from storage.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Searches notes by query string and optional category filter, matching title or content.

methods.name: getAllCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all categories as a set of strings.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Adds a new category after trimming whitespace, avoiding blanks.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Serializes a list of notes to JSON and saves it to SharedPreferences.

methods.name: jsonToNote
methods.description: Deserializes a JSONObject into a Note instance.

methods.name: noteToJson
methods.description: Serializes a Note instance into a JSONObject.
